dedupe_keys.name: epanet inp files used in paper

description: EPA supplies EPANET INP network files used to examine water-quality mass imbalances. The metadata also names TEVA-SPOT-GUI as compatible software. This resource is provided by U.S. EPA Office of Research and Development (ORD). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists application/x-zip-compressed formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence terms are linked in the provider metadata and require reading before reuse. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Classified as network model specifications, not observations. The files support one publication and were not run. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
